The following observations were collected during experimentation on an inorganic salt:
- The solution of this salt in distilled water is slightly basic.
- Addition of Sr(NO3)2 to this solution results in a white precipitate that dissolves in nitric acid.
- Addition of AgNO3 to the original solution does not cause any precipitation.

Assuming that all of the above statements are true, which of the following options is correct?
